args: CB=$(ls -t /tmp/coder.*/coder 2>/dev/null | head -1); [ -z "$CB" ] && CB=coder; export ATLASSIAN_OAUTH_ACCESS_TOKEN=$("$CB" external-auth access-token atlassian 2>/dev/null); export ATLASSIAN_OAUTH_CLOUD_ID=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $ATLASSIAN_OAUTH_ACCESS_TOKEN" https://api.atlassian.com/oauth/token/accessible-resources 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.[0].id // empty'); export ATLASSIAN_OAUTH_ENABLE=true; exec uvx mcp-atlassian
